name: Update house listings

on:
  workflow_dispatch:

  schedule:
    # 毎日、日本時間06:20に実行
    # UTC 21:20 = JST 06:20
    - cron: "20 21 * * *"

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: update-house-listings
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  update:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"

    steps:

      # =====================================================
      # 1. リポジトリを取得
      # =====================================================
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1

      # =====================================================
      # 2. Python環境を設定
      # =====================================================
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"
          cache: "pip"

      # =====================================================
      # 3. 依存ライブラリをインストール
      # =====================================================
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      # =====================================================
      # 4. 実行コミット確認
      # =====================================================
      - name: Show execution revision
        run: |
          echo "========================================"
          echo "Execution revision"
          echo "========================================"
          git rev-parse HEAD
          git log -1 --oneline
          echo ""
          echo "main.py parser version:"
          grep -n "MAIN_PARSER_VERSION" scripts/main.py
          echo ""
          echo "detail.py parser version:"
          grep -n "DETAIL_PARSER_VERSION" scripts/adapters/suumo_detail.py
          echo ""
          echo "identity.py:"
          grep -n "def make_property_id" scripts/identity.py

      # =====================================================
      # 4.5 Python構文・抽出回帰テスト
      # =====================================================
      - name: Compile and test extraction
        env:
          PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
        run: |
          python - <<'PY'
          import ast
          from pathlib import Path
          for root in (Path("scripts"), Path("tests")):
              for path in root.rglob("*.py"):
                  ast.parse(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"), filename=str(path))
          print("Python syntax: OK")
          PY
          python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

      # =====================================================
      # 5. SUUMO検索・物件統合・詳細情報取得
      # =====================================================
      - name: Discover and fetch house listings
        run: |
          python scripts/main.py

      # =====================================================
      # 6. 生成データを検証（summary.jsonの実スキーマと整合）
      # =====================================================
      - name: Validate generated data
        run: |
          python scripts/validate_data.py

      # =====================================================
      # 9. 変更されたJSONを確認
      # =====================================================
      - name: Show changed files
        run: |
          echo "===== Git status ====="
          git status --short

          echo ""
          echo "===== Git diff stat ====="
          git diff --stat

      # =====================================================
      # 10. 生成データをコミット・プッシュ
      # =====================================================
      - name: Commit and push changes
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"

          git add data/discovered_listings.json data/houses.json data/listing_observations.json data/summary.json

          if git diff --cached --quiet; then
            echo "No changes to commit"
          else
            git commit -m "Update house listings"
            git push
          fi
